text:
sandeep: Heads up — onboarding for Org-Helix (acct 123456789012) hit a hard stop when CI tried to launch p5/g5 instances in ap-northeast-2. Job failed with EC2 launch errors.
raj: what did the runner log show?
sandeep: launcher output:
```
bot: error launching instance: InvalidParameterValue: InsufficientInstanceCapacity: We currently do not have sufficient p5.24xlarge capacity in ap-northeast-2 for your request.
```
maria: could be quota = 0 for new account/region or actual physical capacity shortage in the AZ. infra-bot, what do we have on service quotas for org-helix?
infra-bot: Note: org-helix is a newly created account under the org (org-id: o-0abc123). Default GPU instance quotas in ap-northeast-2 are 0 for p4/p5/g5 families unless increased.
sandeep: ran a quick check via service-quotas CLI:
```
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --region ap-northeast-2
# response: Quota value: 0
```
alex: action items: (A) file service-quotas increase for the GPU families, (B) open AWS Support case asking for expedited capacity review / temporary reservation since this is a new account.
maria: add ENI and vCPU quota bumps too. Last onboarding we hit ENI exhaustion per-subnet when packing many GPU nodes in one AZ. Also request EFA / placement-group allowances for p5 if possible.
raj: let's request a staged increase: initial target 5 x p5.24xlarge, 10 x g5.12xlarge, 2 x p4d for smoke/perf testing. Ask AWS to allow burst/temporary reservation for 48 hours while we run validation.
sandeep: budget signal: if fully used on-demand for a month that's ~ $80k. Prefer a short-term burst/reservation rather than permanent excess quotas.
alex: filed the service-quotas requests (refs: SQ-APNE2-457, SQ-APNE2-458, SQ-APNE2-459) and opened a support case (case: 9876543210) under Redwood Inference / Org-Helix.
aws-support: Thanks for the request. We've provisionally applied a soft quota increase pending capacity validation. To provision capacity immediately we need: requested start time, estimated sustained vCPU usage, and confirmation whether alternate AZs in ap-northeast-2 are acceptable.
maria: reply: start tomorrow 09:00 JST, sustained peak ~150 vCPUs for 48h, can accept any AZ in the region. Also ask for guidance on ENI per-subnet limits for large GPU groups.
raj: AWS came back: they can approve a partial capacity reservation within 24-36 hours. Temporary increases applied: p5 -> 5, g5 -> 8, p4d -> 1. Remaining g5s pending due to rack-level inventory. Recommend on-demand capacity reservation (OCR) if we need firm guarantees.
sandeep: ok. We'll update CI to accept the partial pool and fall back to a p4d/g5 mix if g5s are unavailable. Also aim to move to reserved instances or dedicated capacity after validation.
leanne: networking note — when we spin >10 GPUs in a single subnet we hit ENI/IP exhaustion. Recommend pre-creating two subnets in different AZs with ample free IPs (/24 each) and proper route table tags for GPU-node groups.
alex: I drafted a small verification runbook for the onboarding team:
```
# list live GPU instances
aws ec2 describe-instances --filters "Name=instance-type,Values=p5.24xlarge,g5.12xlarge,p4d.24xlarge" --region ap-northeast-2
# check service quotas
aws service-quotas get-aws-default-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A --region ap-northeast-2
# check ENI usage per-subnet
aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters "Name=status,Values=available,attached" --region ap-northeast-2
```
raj: owners/todo: alex -> support comms and follow up phone auth (done), leanne -> create two GPU subnets in different AZs and reserve IPs, sandeep -> update CI launch config with fallback instance-type list, infra-bot -> create tracker INFRA-4023 and ping capacity-ops.
infra-bot: tracker created: INFRA-4023. Notifying #capacity-ops and #eng-infra.
sandeep: will run the test tomorrow morning and report back. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
